items.html: We shall first explain the matter of the Partzuf of Arich Anpin, how the ten Sefirot within it divide, for nine Sefirot are the aspect of Arich Anpin, since the Nukva is not revealed in it, as above. And the whole aspect of Arich Anpin is called the Keter of the entirety of all Atzilut, and this Keter divides into nine Sefirot, and the whole of this is what is called Arich Anpin. And we have already explained the matter of the clothing of all the Partzufim of Atzilut, one within the other, so that it is found that from each Partzuf only its Rosh is revealed; and then all these heads, one below the other, are all drawn together in the aspect of a single Partzuf that includes all of Atzilut in its entirety. And then, since from all of Arich Anpin nothing was revealed unclothed except its Keter — for even the Hochma within it is concealed inside this Keter — therefore the whole of Arich Anpin is called only Keter alone. And afterward, immediately below it, come the two revealed heads of Aba ve Ima, becoming the aspect of Hochma-Bina (HB) of the entirety of Atzilut. And below them comes the Rosh of Zeir Anpin down to its navel, becoming the body of Atzilut in its entirety. And afterward the Nukva of Zeir Anpin is revealed, and is called the Malchut of the entirety of Atzilut. Indeed, there is no Partzuf that does not contain within it the entirety of the ten Sefirot, and they clothe within another Partzuf in the aspect of its body alone; and likewise the second within the third, and so with all of them.
